products.name: Arize AI
products.note: ML observability; LLM tracing; evaluation framework; prompt monitoring

profile_text.body:
Arize AI is a company that describes itself as an agent observability, evaluation, and improvement platform for AI engineering. Its tools are designed to help teams trace LLM calls, run evaluations, debug issues, monitor production performance, and continuously improve prompts, models, and workflows across AI applications including chatbots, RAG systems, copilots, and agents.

The company offers two main products. Phoenix is described as an open-source platform for AI observability and evaluation, built on OpenInference and OpenTelemetry standards, which can be run locally or self-hosted. Arize AX is a managed platform built on the same open standards that adds managed infrastructure, advanced agent observability, online evaluations, and continual improvement workflows. The company also offers a tool called Alyx, described as an AI engineering assistant that runs evaluations, debugs issues, and improves agents. Arize states it integrates with more than 40 models, frameworks, and tools, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Amazon Bedrock, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, the OpenAI Agents SDK, and DSPy.

The site's held facts list Arize AI under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, with noted capabilities spanning ML observability, LLM tracing, an evaluation framework, and prompt monitoring. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
